name: Ministro Pistarini International Airport (Ezeiza)

handling.v: business jets and air taxis use the FBO VIPCLUB, a separate terminal with its own access to the airport
handling.quote: Ofrece un servicio diferenciado para la atención de las aeronaves de aviación ejecutiva y taxis aéreos, mediante una terminal con acceso independiente al aeropuerto.

notes: The Argentine AIP (ANAC, ais.anac.gob.ar) could not be read: the session proxy refused the host and the web reader is blocked by the site's robots rules. All AD 2 facts (coordinates, runway, hours, customs, night rules) still need the AD 2 SAEZ PDF; Morten may download it from ais.anac.gob.ar. The FBO page lists customs (Aduana), Migraciones and other control bodies as present at the FBO terminal and shows a list of authorised handlers only as logos (not quotable text). Aeropuertos Argentina's Ezeiza pages did not state hours, distance or that the company operates EZE, so operator is left unverified.
